Note::sizes¶

Back to Note API Reference

Signature¶

std::vector<std::int64_t> Note::sizes() const

Materialize The Complete Shape¶

sizes() returns every axis extent from first to last. Its vector length is exactly dim(), and the product of its entries is numel(). A scalar therefore returns an empty vector: rank zero has no axes even though the scalar contains one cell. A zero-sized dimension is retained rather than removed.

The returned vector owns its integers. Changing or destroying it cannot change the Note, and the Note may be destroyed while the vector remains in use. The cell arena is neither copied nor exposed. This makes sizes() appropriate for persisting geometry or passing it to another constructor; use size(dim) to avoid the small allocation when only one extent is needed.

An undefined handle has no shape and raises pluss::Error. Call defined() first when absence is possible.

Example 1: Scalar Through Rank Three¶

auto print_sizes = [](const pluss::Note& value) {
  const auto shape = value.sizes();
  std::cout << '[';
  for (std::size_t i = 0; i < shape.size(); ++i)
    std::cout << (i ? ", " : "") << shape[i];
  std::cout << "]\n";
};

print_sizes(pluss::note::make("a"));
print_sizes(pluss::note::make({"a"}));
print_sizes(pluss::note::make({{"a", "b"}}));

Output¶

[]
[1]
[1, 2]

Example 2: The Shape Vector Is An Independent Value¶

const auto note = pluss::note::make({{"a", "b", "c"}, {"d", "e", "f"}});
auto shape = note.sizes();
shape[0] = 99;
std::cout << "copy=[" << shape[0] << ", " << shape[1] << "] "
          << "note=[" << note.size(0) << ", " << note.size(1) << "]\n";

Output¶

copy=[99, 3] note=[2, 3]

Example 3: Empty Geometry And Undefined Handles¶

const auto empty = pluss::note::make(
    std::vector<std::string>{}, std::array<std::int64_t, 2>{2, 0});
const auto shape = empty.sizes();
std::cout << "empty sizes=[" << shape[0] << ", " << shape[1] << "]\n";

try {
  (void)pluss::Note::undefined().sizes();
} catch (const pluss::Error&) {
  std::cout << "undefined.sizes(): rejected\n";
}

Output¶

empty sizes=[2, 0]
undefined.sizes(): rejected
